content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Custom Metadata Types ## slug: custom-metadata ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## Introduction Custom Metadata Types are used in Blackthorn apps to automatically install metadata records into your org. Many packaged apex triggers use these records. The purpose of this documentation is a reference for these records' functions. For example, we have a Custom Metadata Type called "Stripe Currency Setting" that stores all the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} currency information like the ISO code, minimum amount, supported bank accounts, etc. and is used to validate your {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s and {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. ## Custom Metadata Types There are two Custom Metadata Type records: Stripe Connect Country Specs and Stripe Currency Setting. 1. Navigate to Custom Metadata Types. ***Lightning:** Setup > In the Quick Find, search and click "Custom Metadata Types."* 2. Click "Manage Records" next to either Custom Metadata Type. You can update the records by clicking Edit next to the record name. ### Stripe Currency Setting ![H_01_04_Stripe Currency Setting](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_04_Stripe%20Currency%20Setting.png){height="" width=""} ### Stripe Connect Country Specs ![H_01_04_Stripe Connect Country Specs](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_04_Stripe%20Connect%20Country%20Specs.png){height="" width=""} ## Troubleshooting If you have received an error with your Custom Metadata Types or have a question, please view our [Troubleshooting](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-troubleshooting){target=`_blank`} or [FAQ](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-faq){target=`_blank`} page.
